mwva89.treasure:
Congratulations, Player One. You found the Golden Easter Egg!

You made it here without a mouse. You used ls to look around, cd to move from room to room, cat to read every clue, and rm and rmdir to clear away everything that wasn't real. That is the secret of the terminal: you can see everything, as long as you know how to look.

When I built the OASIS, I hid from the real world for far too long. Don't make my mistake. Go play, go build things, and go show your friends how you got here.

Thanks for playing my game.
- James Halliday
